candidateNoOpenColorFarFieldLemma.statement: If the same retained branch-interface and confinement-functional record supplies accepted finite_range_residual, accepted color_singlet_closure, accepted same_record_no_open_color_audit, accepted proton and neutron branch-interface ledgers, the same_record_energy_momentum_angular_momentum_ledger, Delta_E_corr_NN_tail_limit, bounded_residual_overlap, large_r_zero_limit, and finite K_open, and the audit proves N_open(R) <= K_open T_NN(R)^2 with lim_R_to_infty T_NN(R)=0, then lim_R_to_infty N_open(R)=0 and the packet has the exact support shape for no_open_color_far_field.

proofSteps.derivation: Build W_no_open=(A_no_open,T_NN,K_open,B_br) in one retained record shared by the branch-interface ledgers, finite residual, color-singlet closure, and audit row.
Consume Delta_E_corr_NN_tail_limit, bounded_residual_overlap, and large_r_zero_limit only as accepted same-record finite-tail rows; do not substitute sample-level finite-tail behavior.
Use N_open(R) <= K_open T_NN(R)^2 with finite K_open to make the open-color far-field norm controlled by the accepted residual tail.
Since lim_R_to_infty T_NN(R)=0 and K_open is finite, K_open T_NN(R)^2 tends to zero, so lim_R_to_infty_N_open_R_eq_0 follows.

Only after this same-record zero-limit audit is accepted can no_open_color_far_field feed nucleon_branch_interface_ledgers, pn_orientation_count, pp_orientation_count, and accepted_branch_interface_rows.
